decisions.why: The package dates this APPAM record 2017-11-03. Grimmer's Stanford-hosted CV records a University of Chicago associate professorship in 2017-2018, between his Stanford appointments. The 2017 Stanford CS directory listing alone does not establish Stanford authorship for this November record; the OpenAlex Stanford affiliation conflicts with the dated employment history.
